env.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Client ID of a Google OAuth "Web application" client. Its authorized redirect URI must be this app's address followed by /auth/google/callback.

env.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Client secret of that Google OAuth client.

env.name: ADMIN_EMAILS
env.description: Comma-separated Google email addresses that are admins (they set the day letter and breaks, remove people, and manage backups).

env.name: ALLOWED_DOMAINS
env.description: Optional. Comma-separated Google Workspace domains allowed to sign in, for example your school's domain. Leave empty to let any Google account sign in.

env.name: EVENT_POSTING
env.description: Who can add events to the shared events board.
